title: Messages
lead: Messages sent through the contact form. Prayer requests are confidential: only people allowed to see them do.
empty_p: Messages from the contact form will arrive here.
delete_p: The message and its notes will be deleted for good.

site.form_p: A question, a prayer, a wish to visit? Write to us: the team replies.
site.name: Your name
site.reach_help: At least one of the two, so we can reply.
site.consent: I agree that the parish keeps this message and my contact details in order to reply.
site.consent_help: We only use them to reply. Messages are deleted after handling (see the privacy policy for the time).
site.prayer_help: A prayer request is confidential: only authorised people read it.
site.sent_p: Thank you! We will reply as soon as we can.
site.err: The message did not go. Check the fields and try again.
site.err_fast: One moment: try again in a few seconds.
site.err_rate: You have sent several messages. Please try again a little later.
site.err_reach: Give an e-mail or a phone number.
site.err_consent: Tick the box so we can keep your message.
site.nojs: The form needs JavaScript. Write to us by e-mail or phone.
